adjudication.rationale: Looking at parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts lines 7-10, the schema uses `[z.string().toString()]` as computed property keys. In JavaScript/TypeScript, `z.string().toString()` evaluates to a string like '[object Object]' or similar, not a dynamic key pattern. Zod doesn't support wildcard/dynamic keys this way - you'd need z.record() for that. This means the minimumTokenResponseSchema only validates `access_token` and two literal string properties, not arbitrary numeric expiry fields. When APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED is true, this broken schema is used instead of the proper app-specific schema, which would strip important fields like expiry_date, refresh_token, etc. from the credential data being saved.
